task: In Production, set up (but do not start) an experiment named "wishlist_sync_copy test" on the multivariate flag "wishlist_sync_copy". Hypothesis: "Try it free" increases add to cart versus "Start free trial". The primary metric "add_to_cart" should increase, and "support_ticket_opened" is a guardrail that should not increase. Split users evenly between the control and the variation.

changes.after: "Try it free" increases add to cart versus "Start free trial"

finalText: DONE: Created experiment "wishlist_sync_copy test" (id 51) in Production with status `created`, not started. It targets the multivariate flag wishlist_sync_copy, with the hypothesis as given. Metrics: add_to_cart (id 86, expected to increase) and support_ticket_opened (id 87, expected not to increase). Control is "Start free trial" (the flag default) and the variation is "Try it free" (option 94), each at 50%. I left `experiment_rollout.enabled` set to false so nothing goes live, and I left the live flag unchanged (still "Start free trial", "Try it free" at 0%). Setting rollout enabled to true, or starting the experiment, were not part of the request. The experiment was created via the raw API because the CLI has no experiments command.
